**10. PROGRAMME SUMMARY**

The overall programme for the Marston Gate Retail Park project is 52 weeks in duration, commencing on 02/10/2023 and completing on 30/09/2024. The programme is divided into the following phases:

- **Phase 1 – Enabling Works (Weeks 1–6):** Site clearance, demolition of existing structures, diversion of services, and establishment of site compound and welfare facilities.
- **Phase 2 – Substructure (Weeks 7–16):** Excavation, foundations, drainage, ground slab, and below-ground service installation.
- **Phase 3 – Superstructure (Weeks 17–28):** Structural steel frame, precast concrete floor planks, roof structure and cladding, and external wall panels.

- **Phase 6 – Completion (Weeks 48–52):** External works, car park surfacing, landscaping, testing, and handover.

The programme is resourced with a peak labour force of approximately 85 operatives across all trades. **10. PROGRAMME SUMMARY**

The overall programme for the Marston Gate Retail Park project is 52 weeks in duration, commencing on 02/10/2023 and completing on 30/09/2024. The programme is divided into the following phases:

**WEEKLY PROGRESS MEETING (WPM) – MINUTES**

**Meeting No:** WPM-2024-29
**Date:** Wednesday 24 July 2024
**Time:** 09:30 – 10:45
**Location:** Site Office, First Floor Meeting Room, Block C Project Site
**Chair:** Margaret Okafor (Project Manager)
**Minute Taker:** Daniel Reeve (Project Co-ordinator)

---

**ATTENDANCE**

| Name | Company / Role |
|------|----------------|
| Margaret Okafor (MO) | ACME Construction – Project Manager |
| David Chen (DC) | ACME Construction – Site Manager |
| Priya Sharma (PS) | ACME Construction – M&E Coordinator |
| James Fletcher (JF) | Sterling Groundworks – Contracts Manager |
| Alan Hughes (AH) | Precision Carpentry – Site Supervisor |
| Tom Whitfield (TW) | JW Electrical – Project Lead |
| Rosie Bennett (RB) | RBS Plumbing & Heating – Director |
| Sam Carter (SC) | Total Security Solutions – Site Supervisor |
| Daniel Reeve (DR) | ACME Construction – Project Co-ordinator |

**Apologies:** Laura Nguyen (Brickwork & Masonry Ltd), Paul Hendricks (HSE Consultant)

---

**1. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MINUTES**

Minutes of the WPM held on Wednesday 17 July 2024 were circulated electronically on 18 July 2024. Approved with no amendments. Actions from that meeting were reviewed (see Action Log, Section 7).

---

**2. SITE SAFETY & WELFARE (Update from 17/07/2024)**

- **Housekeeping:** The general site clean-up scheduled for Friday 19 July was completed. The skip area has been cleared and the segregation bays are now in use. DC to monitor compliance during the shutdown period.
- **Welfare:** The additional toilet unit for Block C workforce remains in satisfactory working order. A minor leak was reported on 22 July; RBS Plumbing attended and repaired the inlet valve on 23 July. No further issues.
- **Site Security:** Total Security Solutions have confirmed that patrol frequency will be increased to twice nightly during the summer shutdown. SC confirmed that the main gate will be locked and alarmed from Friday 26 July, 17:00, until Monday 12 August, 07:00.

---

**3. PROGRESS SUMMARY (Week Ending 26/07/2024)**

- **Block A:** Brickwork to the third floor is complete. Scaffold inspection certificates for the north elevation were received and are valid until 21/08/2024. Roofing works to the east wing commenced on 22 July as planned.
- **Block B:** Concrete frame is complete. The ground floor slab pour was finished on 23 July. Curing compound applied. Formwork striking is underway.
- **Block C:** The drainage connection to the main sewer was completed on 18 July and the chamber has been backfilled. Ducting for the M&E services is running ahead of schedule. First fix electrical to the ground floor is approximately 60% complete.
- **External Works:** The haul road has been re-graded and re-compacted in preparation for the shutdown. The south-west corner area has been cleared of surplus material. The location for the future site compound (as noted in the Monthly Review Meeting of 05/08/2024) is to be kept clear of storage.

---

**4. PROGRAMME – SUMMER SHUTDOWN (Confirmed)**

- The two-week summer shutdown runs from **Monday 29 July 2024 to Friday 09 August 2024 inclusive**. No site deliveries will be accepted during this period. Security contractor has been informed.
- All subcontractors to ensure that their plant and materials are secured and powered down by **Friday 26 July 2024, 16:00**.
- **August bank holiday** falls on Monday 26 August 2024. Non-working day for all subcontractors; no deliveries accepted.
- The next WPM will be held on **Wednesday 14 August 2024** at 09:30. The first WPM after the shutdown will be Wednesday 21 August 2024; minutes of that meeting will be circulated for approval before the break.

**MEETING MINUTES – WEEKLY PROGRESS MEETING (WPM)**

**Project:** Riverside Court Development – Phase 2
**Meeting No.:** WPM-2024-034
**Date:** Wednesday 21 August 2024
**Time:** 09:30 – 11:10
**Location:** Site Office, Portakabin B, Riverside Court
**Chair:** SC (Senior Project Manager)
**Minute Taker:** JT (Project Administrator)

**Attendees:**

| Name | Company | Role |
|------|---------|------|
| SC | Pinnacle Construction Ltd | Senior Project Manager |
| RB | Pinnacle Construction Ltd | Site Manager |
| JT | Pinnacle Construction Ltd | Project Administrator |
| MW | Pinnacle Construction Ltd | Quantity Surveyor |
| DH | Arrow M&E Services | M&E Contract Manager |
| KP | Hartley Brickwork Ltd | Contracts Manager |
| TR | Falcon Roofing Systems | Site Supervisor |
| LN | Total Security Solutions | Account Manager |
| PK | Pinnacle Construction Ltd | Health & Safety Advisor |

**Apologies:** AP (Civils Subcontractor – Groundworks), CD (Client's Representative)

---

**1. SAFETY, HEALTH & ENVIRONMENT**

- PK reported that the post-shutdown safety induction was completed on Monday 19 August for all operatives returning to site. Attendance register is held in the site office.
- A near miss was recorded on 20 August involving a pallet of roof tiles being moved by telehandler; the load shifted but was secured without injury. PK has reviewed the lifting plan with Falcon Roofing Systems and a toolbox talk on slinging and signalling was given to all banksmen on site.
- PK noted that the monthly H&S inspection is scheduled for Thursday 29 August. PK to circulate the inspection checklist to all trade contractors by Friday 23 August.
- **Action 34-01:** PK to chase the updated Construction Phase Plan from the Principal Designer. The current version on site is dated 12/04/2024 and the designer has confirmed a revision is in progress. PK to chase for issue by end of August. **Status: Open – Due 30/08/2024.**

---

**2. PROGRESS SUMMARY (WEEK ENDING 23/08/2024)**

- **Block A:** Roofing works to the east wing are progressing well. TR reported that the main roof membrane is approximately 80% complete. Leadwork to the parapets has started. Scaffold inspection certificates for the north elevation remain valid until 21/08/2024; a re-inspection was carried out by the scaffold contractor on 20 August and a new certificate is expected to be issued on Friday 23 August.
- **Block B:** Formwork striking to the ground floor is complete. The first floor slab pour is now scheduled for Tuesday 27 August, subject to weather. RB to confirm the concrete pour date with the ready-mix supplier by Friday 23 August.
- **Block C:** First fix electrical to the ground floor is now complete. DH confirmed that the M&E ducting to the first floor has commenced. The drainage connection to the main sewer was completed on 18 July and the chamber has been backfilled; no further work is required in that area.
- **External Works:** The haul road has been re-graded and re-compacted in preparation for the shutdown. The south-west corner area has been cleared of surplus material. The location for the future site compound (as noted in the Monthly Review Meeting of 05/08/2024) is to be kept clear of storage.
- MW reported that the valuation for the August interim payment is being prepared. The next valuation date is 31 August 2024. MW to issue the draft valuation to the client's QS by Tuesday 27 August.

---

**3. SUMMER SHUTDOWN – REVIEW AND RETURN TO WORK**

- SC confirmed that the summer shutdown ran from Monday 29 July 2024 to Friday 09 August 2024 inclusive. The site was closed and no deliveries were accepted during this period.
- LN confirmed that Total Security Solutions increased patrol frequency to twice nightly during the shutdown. The main gate was locked and alarmed from Friday 26 July, 17:00, until Monday 12 August, 07:00. No security incidents were reported during the shutdown period.
- RB reported that the site was re-opened on Monday 12 August and a full site walkdown was carried out. No damage or vandalism was noted. All plant was found to be in good order.
- The August bank holiday falls on Monday 26 August 2024. This is a non-working day for all subcontractors; no deliveries will be accepted.
